'''Syncronics''' was a manufacturing company that specialized in a variety of clothing for use by those in dangerous lines of work. Their best known product was the [[ENVC-370 Glove]], a modified environmental [[Body glove/Legends|body glove]] that could absorb energy from [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots.
